mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the handle was most worthwhile because the completed projector then showed stars on a screen.

leastWorthwhile.text: Turning the box was less engaging: the described front opening changed only subtly from the previous view.

surprise.text: The final motion moved from the projector to a view of stars, showing its intended effect rather than just the mechanism.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the goals clearly explained each fitting, although most steps offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another completed moving creation, though the mostly prescribed steps leave little room for meaningful choices.
